latest.title: Unbounded normalized scalar curvature integrals in dimension four
latest.abstract: We give counterexamples to Yau's question on normalized scalar curvature integrals in every dimension $n\geq4$. For each such $n$, there exists a smooth complete Riemannian metric $g$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ with nonnegative Ricci curvature and a pole such that \[ \lim_{R\to\infty}R^{2-n}\int_{B_q(R)}\mathrm{Scal}_g\,\mathrm dV_g=+\infty \] for every fixed $q\in\mathbb{R}^n$. Here $B_q(R)$ denotes the geodesic ball of radius $R$ centered at $q$, and $\mathrm{Scal}_g$ is the scalar curvature of $g$.
latest.workSummary: 声称在每个 n≥4 的 Rⁿ 上构造具有极点、Ricci 非负的完备度量，使归一化标量曲率积分在任意固定中心发散。
techniques: 塌缩环面对称 S³ 截面
端点通量与标量曲率积分
latest.breakthrough: 把相关 Yau 问题的反例推进至四维及更高维，并控制中心选择。
latest.limitations: 应与同日三维塌缩反例比较；存在极点不等于渐近体积比为正。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。 四维主例的渐近体积比确为零。

latest.priorityReason: 与核心曲率积分问题直接相关，需核查正性、完备性及发散估计。
